name: Omelet
author: based.cooking contributors
steps: Add tapioca, salt and pepper to milk; cook in double boiler 15 minutes or until tapioca is clear and mixture thickened, stirring frequently.
Allow it to cool; combine with egg yolks, stirring occasionally.
Pour egg mixture into hot buttered frying pan.
Omelet is done when an inserted knife comes out clean.
Cut across at right angles to handle of pan, being careful not to cut all the way through.
Fold carefully from handle to opposite side and serve on hot platter.
Add 1/2 cup grated sharp Cheddar Cheese just before folding in egg whites.
Before putting omelet in oven, sprinkle top with an additional 1/2 cup of grated cheese.

culture.text: An omelette is a dish made from eggs, fried with butter or oil in a frying pan. It is a common practice for an omelette to include fillings such as chives, vegetables, mushrooms, meat, cheese, onions or some combination of the above. Whole eggs or egg whites are often beaten with a small amount of milk, cream, or water.
